A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MOVIS and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D. Corresponding material can be matched despite figure renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original NVS evaluations, component and scheduler ablations, and occlusion experiments in Tables 1–2 and S.3–S.6.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds Free3D comparisons and qualitative results from additional real-world sources.

M1.justification: The depth/mask conditioning, auxiliary mask-prediction loss, DINO and camera embeddings, and structure-guided timestep schedule remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: The existing five evaluation datasets are retained. v2 Figure S.8 adds six qualitative examples from YouTube, RealEstate10K, and ScanNet++, providing a limited expansion of real-world input coverage for the same NVS task.

E2.justification: v2 adds Free3D to Table 1 on C3DFS, Objaverse, and Room-Texture, and to Figure 4 and the appendix qualitative comparison. ZeroNVS, Zero-1-to-3, and the C3DFS-retrained Zero-1-to-3 are retained.

E3.justification: The documented splits, training and inference settings, evaluation metrics, and 20-pixel matching thresholds remain unchanged in Section 4.1 and Appendix B. The additional qualitative examples introduce no documented procedural change; revised scores alone do not establish one.

E4.justification: Table S.5 revises the ablation evidence concerning depth conditioning. On Room-Texture, removing depth changes from reducing Hit Rate relative to the full model (5.5 versus 6.1) to increasing it (5.0 versus 4.4). The ablation variants, scheduler comparisons, occlusion study, and failure cases are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The Gaussian sampler's variance is a method parameter, not uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Tables 1 and S.5 substantially revise cross-view scores and some ablation rankings. MOVIS Hit Rate changes from 37.0 to 19.3 on C3DFS, 50.0 to 17.0 on Objaverse, and 6.1 to 4.4 on Room-Texture. Existing PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and IoU values remain unchanged. Free3D scores and new real-world qualitative outputs are also added. The PDFs do not explain the cross-view score revisions.

T1.justification: The loss and sampling equations, matching procedures in Algorithms 1–2, and occlusion-category definitions are unchanged. No new theoretical result, derivation, or proof appears.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about structural conditioning, mask prediction, timestep scheduling, consistency evaluation, and generalization. The additional experiments support these existing claims without redefining the contributions.

C2.justification: The explanations of global placement versus local-detail learning and occlusion handling remain unchanged. Appendix C retains the same limitations concerning delicate structures, consistency between generated views, and background modeling; the revised scores receive no new interpretation.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page link at the end of the abstract. Model implementation, data preparation, hardware, training duration, and inference disclosures in Appendices A–B remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether code or data became available through that page.

R1.justification: v2 adds application citations for scene understanding, interaction, design, and robotics, alongside related works such as SlotLifter, PhyRecon, and Free3D. These additions broaden the references, while the three related-work strands and the stated distinction from prior approaches remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 lightly edits the introduction and contribution wording, updates author footnotes, and adds an acknowledgment. The section order and most method, experimental, and appendix prose are retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds Figure S.8, inserts Free3D columns into the qualitative comparisons and rows into Table 1, and reorders Table 1's dataset blocks. Appendix figures and Table S.6 are reflowed and renumbered; the existing methodological and supplementary illustrations are retained.

improvement.justification: Free3D comparisons across the three quantitative benchmarks and six additional real-world examples modestly broaden the evidence for the existing claims. The project-page link improves access information. These gains are limited: the new real-world evidence is qualitative, and the substantial cross-view score revisions are unexplained under unchanged documented protocols, so they cannot be credited as validated corrections.
